review_candidates.description: AWS DevOps Engineer Job DescriptionAbout The Company 83zero Ltd is a leading technology solutions provider specializing in delivering innovative cloud infrastructure and DevOps services to a diverse range of clients across various sectors. With a strong focus on security, scalability, and resilience, 83zero Ltd has established a reputation for excellence in cloud engineering, automation, and digital transformation. Our team comprises highly skilled professionals dedicated to creating tailored solutions that meet the unique needs of each client, ensuring optimal performance and security in their cloud environments. We are committed to fostering a collaborative and inclusive work culture that encourages continuous learning and professional growth. About The Role We are seeking an experienced AWS DevOps Engineer to join our dynamic engineering team. In this role, you will be instrumental in designing, deploying, and managing secure and scalable cloud infrastructure on AWS. Your expertise will enable organizations to modernize their technology estates through automation, Infrastructure as Code, and advanced DevOps practices. This position offers a unique opportunity to work on mission-critical environments, solving complex infrastructure challenges and implementing best practices for cloud security and efficiency. As a hands-on engineer, you will collaborate closely with architects, stakeholders, and fellow engineers to enhance cloud platforms and streamline operational processes. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a strong technical background with practical experience in cloud infrastructure and DevOps methodologies. Candidates must have an active SC clearance, with those based in Bristol holding active DV clearance. A UK nationality is required for security clearance purposes. Essential qualifications include demonstrable experience with AWS cloud services, Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi, and CI/CD pipelines using tools like GitLab CI, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions. Proficiency in containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, along with scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell, is necessary. A solid understanding of AWS networking components, monitoring and logging tools, and cloud security principles, including Zero Trust, is also required. Candidates should exhibit strong troubleshooting skills, experience working within Agile environments, and a proactive approach to adopting emerging cloud-native and DevOps technologies. Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain secure and scalable AWS cloud infrastructure tailored to client requirements. Create and manage Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi to automate infrastructure deployment and updates. Develop, test, and optimize CI/CD pipelines to facilitate continuous integration and continuous delivery of applications and services. Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and observability solutions to ensure high availability and performance of cloud environments. Automate operational tasks and infrastructure management through scripting to improve efficiency and reduce manual interventions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including architects and stakeholders, to align cloud solutions with business objectives. Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and deployment issues, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal performance. Apply cloud security best practices, including Zero Trust architecture, to safeguard cloud environments and data. Evaluate new cloud-native and DevOps tools and technologies, recommending adoption where appropriate to enhance capabilities. Participate in Agile development cycles, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives to ensure timely delivery of projects. Benefits 83zero Ltd offers a competitive salary package ranging from 75,000 to 80,000 GBP, complemented by comprehensive benefits including pension and healthcare options. The role provides a hybrid working model, offering flexibility to work remotely while occasionally traveling to our offices in central London or Manchester. Employees benefit from ongoing professional development opportunities, access to cutting-edge technologies, and a collaborative work environment that encourages innovation. We also promote a healthy work-life balance and support our team members' career growth through mentorship and training programs. Equal Opportunity 83zero Ltd is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees. We value diversity and are dedicated to ensuring that all candidates and employees are treated fairly, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to innovate and deliver exceptional solutions to our clients. All employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.

Service reliability and platform stability: Drive improvements in availability, resiliency, SLA performance, incident reduction, and time to restore service for critical trading and execution platforms supporting the Securities Finance business. Proven track record of leading incident, problem, and change management, delivering measurable improvements in stability, reduction of recurring issues, and strong service recovery execution in high-pressure trading environments. Strong ownership mentality and execution focus, with the ability to take initiatives from concept through delivery and embed sustainable outcomes. Deep technical and operational experience across production environments, including monitoring, observability, resiliency, infrastructure, middleware, cloud, and application support within complex enterprise ecosystems. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively across front office trading, business, operations, and engineering teams. review_candidates.description: Remote | Full-Time | 40 hours/week Rate: $5.50/hour + performance-based increase after 6 months Tentative Schedule: Tuesday to Saturday, approximately 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Central Time. Schedule may be adjusted based on business needs. About The Role We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Virtual Assistant to support a growing family entertainment business with customer service, sales follow-up, community outreach, marketing execution, and day-to-day remote operations. This is not a traditional task-based VA role. You will be expected to take ownership of recurring responsibilities, recognize what needs attention, follow opportunities through completion, and work independently without waiting for daily instructions. A major focus of the role is providing customers with a consistent and responsive experience, particularly for birthday parties, group visits, memberships, and other inquiries. The position also supports relationship-building with schools and community organizations to generate new business opportunities. Key Responsibilities 1. Customer Experience & Sales Follow-Up Answer and return customer calls, emails, voicemails, and online inquiries promptly and professionally. Assist customers with questions about birthday parties, group visits, memberships, admissions, schedules, policies, pricing, and availability. Follow up on birthday inquiries, missed calls, abandoned bookings, and prospective customers to help convert interest into confirmed bookings. Maintain consistent and accurate communication so customers receive the same information regardless of when or how they contact the business. Identify complaints, exceptions, or concerns that require management attention and escalate them appropriately. 2. Lead Management, Community Outreach & Growth Maintain CRM records, including contacts, opportunities, notes, pipeline stages, next steps, and follow-up dates. Proactively nurture active leads and follow up until opportunities are booked, completed, or appropriately closed. Research and conduct outreach to schools, PTOs, daycares, preschools, homeschool groups, sports organizations, churches, and community partners. Support opportunities such as group visits, field trips, fundraisers, community events, birthday parties, and partnership programs. Track outreach activity and provide clear visibility into pipeline progress, outstanding opportunities, and necessary follow-up actions. 3. Marketing & Remote Operations Support Manage approved customer email campaigns, audience segmentation, promotions, reactivation efforts, and basic campaign tracking. Maintain the content calendar, schedule approved social media posts, and assist with basic graphics and promotional materials. Support employee scheduling, recruiting coordination, onboarding administration, and routine communication with vendors, candidates, and partners. Maintain trackers, shared files, templates, documentation, and standard operating procedures for recurring processes. Assist with additional administrative needs such as ordering, inventory administration, payroll preparation, reporting, or website/content updates as assigned. Required Qualifications Excellent spoken and written English. Professional, confident, and friendly phone presence. Experience in customer service, sales follow-up, lead management, relationship management, or a similar customer-facing role. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment. Strong follow-through and ability to act with appropriate urgency. Comfortable learning new systems, following processes, and documenting workflows. Availability to work during Central Time business hours. Qualities We Value We are looking for someone who demonstrates: Ownership: You take responsibility for your work and do not need to be reminded repeatedly about outstanding tasks. Proactive thinking: You identify follow-ups, opportunities, and potential problems before they are pointed out. Clear communication: You communicate professionally and confidently with customers, partners, and internal team members. Attention to detail: You understand that small communication errors can create larger operational problems. Critical thinking and problem-solving: You can assess situations, determine the appropriate next action, and know when something should be escalated. Consultation Consistency and reliability: You follow through on commitments and make sure active opportunities do not get forgotten. Preferred Experience Experience in one or more of the following is an advantage: CRM and sales pipeline management Email marketing and customer segmentation Social media scheduling and basic content creation Canva or similar design tools Outbound sales, community outreach, or partnership development Hospitality, events, family entertainment, party planning, or other consumer-facing businesses Tools You May Work With The role may involve tools for CRM and email marketing, business phone management, booking/POS, employee scheduling and payroll, Google Workspace, shared file management, workflow tracking, content creation, and website administration . Current systems include Brevo, Nextiva, LilyPad, Homebase, Google Workspace, Airtable, Google Drive, Canva, ChatGPT, and Base44. What Success Looks Like You will be successful in this role when customer inquiries receive timely responses, leads consistently receive follow-up, active opportunities always have a clear next step, community outreach continues moving forward, marketing activities are completed on schedule, and routine operational work is handled without constant supervision.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Right Job Security Solutions is a leading provider of low voltage (ELV) and integrated security solutions across Saudi Arabia. Its portfolio includes advanced security systems, ICT and networking services, automation solutions. Field Support Technician (4 POSITIONS) Job Summary: The Field Support Technician will provide on-site technical support across schools in Yanbu, diagnosing and repairing hardware, printers, scanners, and local data networks. Key Responsibilities: Perform daily field visits using company service vehicles (Pick-Up) to respond to critical helpdesk tickets. Execute preventive and corrective maintenance for desktop PCs, laptops, and computer labs. Inspect and test Cat6 network drops and patch panels using advanced network testers. Replace printer toners, rollers, and handle hardware/paper jam troubleshooting. Fill out technical service checklists and close maintenance tickets upon client sign-off. Qualifications & Requirements: Education: Minimum IT Diploma or Associate Degree in Electronics/Computer Engineering. Experience: Minimum of 2 years hands-on experience in IT field maintenance. License: Valid KSA Driving License. Skills: Strong troubleshooting skills in Windows OS, hardware diagnostics, and cabling standards. Central Computer Maintenance Technician (1 POSITION) Job Summary: Stationed at the Education Administration Building in Yanbu, the Central Maintenance Technician performs component-level bench repairs, electronics diagnostics, and hardware upgrades for computers and printers. Key Responsibilities: Perform motherboard, power supply, and cooling fan repairs for enterprise PCs . Upgrade storage drives (SSD 512GB/1TB) and RAM (DDR4/DDR5) with secure data migration. Inspect incoming spare parts against technical specs prior to field release. Service mechanical assemblies, fuser units, and rollers for heavy-duty printers and scanners. Manage the local spare parts buffer stock and temporary backup units (Hot-Swap). Qualifications & Requirements: Education: Minimum IT Diploma or Electronics Engineering Technician Certificate. Experience: Minimum 2 years of proven bench-level hardware/electronics repair experience. Skills: Proficient with Multimeters, soldering tools, and advanced hardware diagnostics tools. AV & Interactive Projector Technician (1 POSITION) Job Summary: Specialized in servicing interactive visual display systems, maintaining projectors and smart interactive boards across Yanbu schools. Key Responsibilities: Inspect, clean dust filters, and calibrate focal alignments for classroom projectors. Replace projector lamps (e.g., NEC NP33LP) and calibrate thermal cooling fans. Align IR touch sensors and touch frames for Smart Interactive Boards and Displays. Test long-range digital signal cabling (HDMI 15M, DisplayPort, 4K Wireless Adapters). Comply with OSHA safety protocols when working at heights during ceiling-mounted projector servicing. Qualifications & Requirements: Education: Diploma in AV Systems, Electronics, or IT Technology. Experience: Minimum 2 years of specialized experience in projector and smart board maintenance. Skills: Expertise in optical calibration, keystone alignment, and display interface troubleshooting.
